name: sh-ast-workspace
description: A synchronous, fully-typed shell AST for JavaScript/TypeScript
author: Mike North <michael.l.north@gmail.com>

scripts.build:docs: NX_TUI=false nx run-many -t uplevel-api-reports --exclude=sh-ast-workspace && pnpm exec api-documenter markdown -i api-docs-temp -o docs
scripts.check: concurrently -n packages,workspace --prefix "[{name}]" "pnpm run check:packages" "pnpm run check:workspace"
scripts.check:workspace: concurrently -n format,knip,syncpack,lint,api-docs --prefix "[{name}]" "pnpm run check:format" "pnpm run check:knip" "pnpm run check:syncpack" "pnpm run check:lint-ts" "pnpm run check:api-docs" && pnpm run check:release
scripts.fix: concurrently -n packages,format,syncpack "pnpm run fix:packages" "pnpm run fix:format" "pnpm run fix:syncpack"
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm run check:release && changeset publish
scripts.test: pnpm run test:release-gate && pnpm run test:tooling && pnpm run test:benchmark && NX_TUI=false nx run-many -t test --exclude=sh-ast-workspace
scripts.test:benchmark: node --test tools/benchmark/*.test.mjs && pnpm build && node --test tools/benchmark/*.integration.mjs
scripts.check:release: pnpm run check:release:changesets && pnpm run check:release:versions
scripts.check:api-docs: NX_TUI=false nx run-many -t uplevel-api-reports --exclude=sh-ast-workspace --skip-nx-cache && node tools/tooling/check-api-docs.mjs
